name: com.dzbuild/dzship
title: dzship: shipping for Algeria
description: Create, track, price and cancel cash-on-delivery parcels with 101 Algerian couriers. No login.

headers.name: X-Courier-Credentials
headers.description: Optional. Your own courier credentials as JSON keyed by courier key, for example {"yalidine":{"apiId":"...","apiToken":"..."}}. Used when a tool call carries none, so they stay out of the conversation. The sandbox courier needs none.
